title: Vance tells Republicans to 'stop whining' about controversial Ohio attack ad
summary_full: The ad by Ohio Republican Vivek Ramaswamy features his Democratic rival's estranged mother, who she has not seen since her stepfather was charged with sexual abuse in her childhood.
